**exp_001 (103 experiments)** — Core SFT training and evaluation pipeline across 3 model scales (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B) and contamination dosages (d000/d005/d025/d100). Key finding: 0.5B shows catastrophic degradation at d100 (MMLU -16.5pp, ARC -17.5pp from d000), small model cannot memorize without losing generalization. 3B GSM8K excluded per D018 due to CoT catastrophic forgetting from LoRA SFT. D020 retrained 3B with conservative params (lr=5e-5) partially recovering GSM8K (11.7% → 35.25% but still below 50% target). D055 unified LoRA alpha=32 across all 3B experiments, triggering the currently RUNNING v3 retrains.

**exp_002 (5 experiments)** — Contamination signal computation. 0.5B signals complete (9/9 PASS). 1.5B signals complete (12/12 PASS). 3B signals attempted twice but failed/killed (GPU conflicts).

**exp_003 (1 experiment)** — RRF fusion of signals for 0.5B. Completed successfully.

**exp_004 (7 experiments)** — IRT simulation sweep (4PL+gamma model). v1-v5 all failed due to infrastructure issues. v6 and v7 currently RUNNING.

**exp_005 (4 experiments)** — Noise propagation. Multiple failures. v4 completed but with "negative" result (ME model underidentified, identifiability limits on gamma recovery at low noise).

**exp_006 (7 experiments)** — IRT fitting on real data. GSM8K NUTS feasible (joint-fit converges: Rhat=1.008, ESS=956, 0 divergences). ARC 2PL fitting succeeded. Several pooled variants tried with mixed results.

**exp_008 (8 experiments)** — Signal survival analysis: 0/3 signals survive across regimes. S1 Embedding has AUC 0.95-0.995 at d005 but random at d000/d100. S2 Min-K++ and S4 Self-Critique random across all regimes. This validates the core claim that individual signals are insufficient and IRT multi-signal fusion is needed. Base pretrained eval showed 99.5% position bias (predict A), ruling out base pretrained as usable regime.

**mvp_sim (2 experiments)** — Both succeeded. 4PL+gamma simulation and confounding analysis completed.
